candidates.change_summary: Replace the zeroing of rewardsForA[recipient] so it is set to a nonzero sentinel (1) before the call, causing different post-withdrawal balance visible after withdrawReward.
Move the storage-zeroing (setting rewardsForA[recipient] = 0) to after the external call so the observable state differs if the call reverts or behaves differently.
Remove resetting of _locked to false at the end of the modifier, leaving _locked true after a call and thus changing reentrancy-related observable behavior.
Move the setting of claimedBonus[recipient] to before withdrawReward, so the bonus is marked claimed prior to withdrawing (changing reentrancy/withdrawal observable outcome).
Remove the call to withdrawReward so the bonus is only recorded in rewardsForA and not withdrawn during this call.
Replace rewardsForA increment with assignment, setting reward to exactly 100 (instead of adding), changing resulting balance after call.

Set claimedBonus to true before require by inserting claimedBonus check removal reorder (move the claim setting to top), which makes require ineffective and changes behavior by allowing repeated calls to proceed differently.
After adding the reward, call withdrawReward with msg.sender instead of recipient, changing which address receives the funds.
